facts.statement: The genus Protarchaeopteryx was described by Q. Ji and S. Ji in 1997.

facts.statement: Protarchaeopteryx lived approximately 124.6 million years ago during the early Aptian age of the Early Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Fossils of Protarchaeopteryx have been found in the Jianshangou bed of the Yixian Formation in China.

facts.statement: The name Protarchaeopteryx means "before Archaeopteryx", despite the fact that it lived in the Cretaceous while Archaeopteryx lived in the Jurassic.

facts.statement: The only known specimen of Protarchaeopteryx is the partial skeleton NGMC 2125.

facts.statement: Protarchaeopteryx had well-developed, vaned feathers extending from a relatively short tail.

facts.statement: Because modern birds with symmetrical feathers cannot fly and the skeletal structure of Protarchaeopteryx would not support flapping flight, it is considered a terrestrial animal.
